subtasks: Observe the object placement order and remember it. Keep both of your arms at their starting poses until the demonstrating arm has fully returned to its starting pose; placing the last object does not mean the demonstration is finished. Only then place the corresponding objects into the basket in the same order. Finally, return both of your arms to their starting poses.
Pick up the near-side green wristwatch and release it into the near-left white basket. Leave the other objects in place.
Pick up the near-side blue phone and release it into the near-left white basket with the green watch.
Place the wooden toy car into the near-left basket. Use the right arm to stage it in the center for the left arm if needed, then release it in the basket.
Pick up the small black electronic device on the table with the left arm and release it inside the near-left basket. Leave the plush animal on the table.
Pick up the remaining plush toy on the table with the left gripper and release it inside the near-left basket, leaving the four placed objects inside.
Keep both grippers fully open. Lift the left gripper clear of the basket and return both arms to their initial resting poses.
